messages:
maria: Hey team — bringing up HF checkpoint 'galena-7b-chat' via the HF->Redwood conversion. Seeing intermittent function-call failures in JSON-mode flows when we quantize to int8. Error looks like tool invocation not found (tool tags duplicated).
ben: Oh interesting. Can you paste a tiny repro? Is it only after quantization? :thinking_face:
maria: Minimal repro:
```
User: "Get weather"
Model output (raw tokens): "<|tool|><|tool|>{\"name\": \"get_weather\", \"args\": {\"city\": \"NYC\"}}"
```

Runtime then tries to parse JSON-mode and sees two tool tags back-to-back so parser thinks the JSON blob starts at second tag and fails to match tool registry -> invocation dropped.
liyah: That token stream looks like the special token got emitted twice. Do we add the special token in template + tokenizer also emitting it as tokenized string? Which tokenizer are you using (HF tokenizer name)?
maria: Using hf_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('galena-7b-chat'). I added special_tokens = {"tool": "<|tool|>", "json_mode": "<|json_mode|>"} via tokenizer.add_special_tokens.
sam: Two hypotheses: 1) The model's generation prefix already contains a tool tag in the chat template, and we're also injecting a tool sentinel at decode time (double-insert). 2) Tokenizer's special token normalization got split into multiple subword ids after the merges created by quantization path (post-quant) causing runtime to reconstruct two tags.
